detail.longDescription: ARTEX: agentic offensive framework driving machine-speed cloud intrusions Wiz and Secureworks both track ARTEX. Wiz reconstructed cases from the operator's own leaked logs. Agents enumerate broadly, retry failures and call APIs faster than a human. Detect on velocity: bursts of List/Describe/Get calls across regions, high AccessDenied ratio from one identity, new access keys or OIDC trusts. # ThreatIntel # CloudSecurity # AIAgents # ARTEX
